description:
Custom player skins manager with support for v1.0 and v1.8 skins and inventory skins selector

This mod version comes with 8 pre-installed skins. To install more,, consult the [instructions in the README.md](https://github.com/minetest-mods/skinsdb/tree/contentdb#installing-skins).


You may as well add skins manually:

* `character_[name or number].png` for skins available to all players or
* `player_[playername]_[name or number].png` for private skins available to the specific player
* (optional) A preview picture (photo) for inventory skin view can be added to the textures folder, named `[same_name_as_skin]_preview.png`
  If no preview file is in place, `skinsdb` generates one from the skin file.
* Optional: Add a metadata text file for inventory skin details view to the "meta" folder, named `[same_name_as_skin].txt` with the following contents:

```
Skin name
Author
License
```
